summary: Quiet residential kerb where cars park, with homes within 25 m all round.

drivers.seclusion: Houses about 20-23 m away across the road and 22-26 m behind the kerb; a home at 10 m near the far end.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain street kerb with a parked car opposite; room for a van along the north kerb.
drivers.convention: Residents park along the street, so a van blends in a little; no signs.

flags: Dwelling 10 m from the 7-10 m end of the stretch
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the north kerb, shading it much of the day.

best_section.where: Swann Road, north kerb, east end of the 10 m stretch
